name: Face Contouring
summary: Jawline definition, cheek volume and facial proportions can be refined without surgery.
leadAnswer: Face contouring addresses the shape and definition of the jawline, chin and cheeks. The same complaint can come from fat under the chin, chewing-muscle bulk, loose skin or a lack of projection, and each is treated differently. Non-surgical treatment works on those soft-tissue layers; it does not change bone.
seoTitle: Face Contouring Treatment & Assessment in Malaysia | Kaiteki
seoDescription: Jawline and chin definition are assessed individually before any face contouring treatment is suggested. Book a free consultation with a Kaiteki doctor.

facts.label: Contouring addresses proportion and definition, and it is not a weight-loss treatment.
Bone, fat, muscle and skin all shape a jawline, and each is treated differently.
Fat, muscle, skin and projection each have a different answer.

sections.heading: What is face contouring?
body: Face contouring refers to the shape, definition and proportion of facial areas such as the jawline, chin and cheeks. It is about how these features relate to one another rather than any single feature in isolation.

drivers.heading: What influences facial contour
drivers.intro: Within the outline bone sets, two soft-tissue changes account for most lost jaw definition:

items.body: as skin and the layer beneath it loosen, tissue settles downward and breaks the jaw into two lines rather than one.
a pocket of fat in the submental area sits between the chin and the neck and blurs the angle between them. It can be present at any weight.

figures.caption: Settled tissue breaks the jaw into two lines.
A fat pocket under the chin blurs the jaw–neck angle.

variant.heading: What's shaping yours?
variant.intro: Most faces involve more than one.

tabs.label: Fat
tabs.title: Fat under the chin or along the jaw
tabs.body: A soft pocket you can pinch, sitting between the chin and the neck or spilling slightly over the jawline.

items.body: you can hold it between finger and thumb, and it softens or shifts when you tip your head back.

tabs.routing: commonly assessed for fat-reduction treatment targeted at the submental area.

tabs.label: Muscle
tabs.sub: Width at the back of the jaw
tabs.title: Chewing-muscle bulk
tabs.body: The masseter muscle at the back of the jaw can be naturally strong or enlarged by clenching and grinding, widening the lower face when viewed from the front.

items.body: clench your teeth and feel just above the angle of the jaw. If a firm bulge pushes out under your fingers, muscle is part of the picture.

tabs.routing: assessed for muscle-relaxing injection, with any dental cause of grinding addressed alongside it.

tabs.label: Skin
tabs.title: Skin and soft-tissue laxity
tabs.body: The jaw outline is intact but the edge is no longer crisp, with small jowls either side of the chin.

items.body: lying down improves it noticeably, and gentle backward tension with a fingertip restores the outline.

tabs.label: Structure
tabs.title: Bone and volume proportion
tabs.body: A recessed chin, a flat mid-face or a short lower third change how defined a jawline looks without anything having sagged.

items.body: in profile, the chin sits well behind the lower lip, or the mid-face reads flat while the jaw itself is unchanged.

tabs.routing: assessed for volume support placed to build projection, with a frank discussion of what proportion allows.

locationBlock.heading: Non-surgical versus surgical
locationBlock.intro: Where non-surgical treatment stops being the right tool:

cards.title: What non-surgical options do
cards.body: They reduce a fat pocket, relax an overactive muscle, firm loose skin or add support where projection is lacking. Each addresses one layer, and the change is proportionate rather than transformative.

cards.title: What surgery does
cards.body: Procedures such as jaw or chin surgery, or surgical removal of tissue, change structure directly.

cards.title: Where the line usually falls
cards.body: Bone is the clearest boundary: if the outline you want requires a different jaw or chin, no injectable or device will produce it.

seeDoctor.heading: When it is worth an assessment
seeDoctor.intro: There is no clinical threshold. It is worth an assessment if:
triggers: The lower face has widened, or you clench and grind your teeth and wake with a tight jaw.
The jawline has lost definition over time rather than always having looked this way.
You have been offered a treatment elsewhere and want a second opinion on whether it matches the cause.
seeDoctor.outro: Jaw tension, grinding and disturbed sleep are worth raising with a doctor or dentist regardless of any cosmetic question, because they have consequences for your teeth.

ctaMid.heading: Fat, muscle or skin?
ctaMid.body: Send us a photo on WhatsApp and a doctor can tell you which it is.

treatmentsIntro: Which fits depends on the layer responsible:

fat-freezing.why: For a defined pocket of fat under the chin
fat-freezing.body: Controlled cooling applied to the submental area to reduce a localised fat pocket.

botulinum-toxin.why: For a wide jaw driven by chewing muscle
botulinum-toxin.body: A small dose placed into the masseter muscle so it works less forcefully and gradually reduces in bulk. The effect is temporary and repeated periodically.

hifu.body: Focused ultrasound delivered beneath the skin to firm the tissue along the jaw.

radiofrequency.why: For skin firmness across the lower face
radiofrequency.body: Heats the dermis to prompt collagen change across a broader area than a focused device.

dermal-fillers.why: For projection at the chin and cheek
dermal-fillers.body: Placed on bone to build structure where projection or proportion is lacking, rather than to fill a line.

firstVisit.intro: Fat, muscle, skin and structure are assessed separately, front-on and in profile.

steps.title: History
steps.body: Your weight history, whether you clench or grind, and any previous injectables, threads or surgery.

steps.title: Examination
steps.body: Including a pinch test under the chin and a clench test at the angle of the jaw.

steps.title: Discussion and plan
steps.body: Which layer is responsible, and whether the outcome you have in mind is achievable, with no obligation to proceed.

visitImages.caption: Focused ultrasound being applied along the jawline, one line at a time, at depths chosen for the area.

items.body: Swelling, bruising, tenderness and numbness over the treated area for several days. Muscle-relaxing injection can cause temporary aching or a feeling of weakness when chewing. Fat-reduction treatment often leaves the area firm and tender for a week or more.
Injectables carry a rare but serious risk of vascular occlusion, and muscle-relaxing injection can, uncommonly, affect a neighbouring muscle and alter the smile temporarily.

items.lead: Asymmetry is normal, and worth knowing about
items.body: Almost every face is asymmetric before treatment. The doctor should point it out at assessment so it is not later mistaken for a treatment effect.
Where energy-based devices are used along the jawline, medium and deeper skin tones carry a higher chance of post-inflammatory pigment change. Settings are chosen conservatively for this reason.

Nothing on this page changes bone, so a jaw or chin outline set by structure will not be produced by injectables or devices. Fat reduction does not tighten loose skin, and muscle-relaxing injection does not remove fat. Effects are not permanent and are maintained rather than fixed.

risks.disclose: Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, take blood thinners, have a neuromuscular condition, have a hernia or cold-sensitivity condition relevant to cooling treatment, have had facial surgery, threads or injectables before, or have a history of cold sores or keloid scarring.

costFactors.intro: Pricing is set after assessment. It depends on:
factors: Which layer is being treated: fat, muscle, skin and structure are entirely different treatments.
The area and how much of it: under the chin only, the jawline, or the lower face as a whole.
The product or device chosen, and how much of it your anatomy calls for.
How many stages, since contouring is often sequenced with a review between stages.
How often maintenance is likely, because muscle-relaxing and volume treatments are repeated over time.

technologyIntro: Contouring draws on cooling, ultrasound, radiofrequency and injectables, because the four things that shape a jawline need four different tools.

faqs.q: How do I know whether it is fat or loose skin under my chin?
faqs.a: The pinch test is the usual starting point: if you can hold it between finger and thumb and it feels soft and substantial, fat is likely part of it. If gently drawing the skin back toward the ear restores the jaw outline, laxity is contributing.

faqs.q: Does treating the masseter muscle change my face shape?
faqs.a: It can, where the muscle is genuinely contributing to width at the back of the jaw. The muscle works less forcefully after treatment and gradually reduces in bulk over weeks, which softens the outline viewed from the front.

In trained hands and with an appropriate product, it is a well-established treatment, but it is not trivial. The chin and jaw area contains arteries, and the serious risk with any filler is accidental placement into a vessel.

faqs.q: Will fat freezing under my chin help me lose weight?
faqs.a: No. It targets a localised pocket in a specific area and does not change your overall weight or treat obesity. It is generally considered for people who are near a stable weight and have a defined pocket that has not responded to diet and exercise.

That risk comes almost entirely from too much product placed to chase a shape the face cannot naturally hold. It is avoided by treating conservatively, staging over sessions and reviewing between them, and by the doctor being willing to say that a request is not proportionate.

Yes, and jaw and chin definition is one of the more common reasons men attend. The assessment differs, because a male jawline is typically wider and more angular and treatment aimed at a narrower outline would be the wrong goal.

faqs.q: Can I bring a photo of the look I want?
faqs.a: Please do. Be prepared for an honest answer: reference images are often of faces with different bone structure, and sometimes the truthful response is that the outline in the picture is not reachable on your face by any non-surgical route.

faqs.q: What if nothing here suits me?
faqs.a: Then that is what the consultation should tell you. If the change you want requires surgery, or if the assessment finds nothing that treatment would meaningfully improve, our doctors will say so and, where appropriate, suggest a surgical opinion.
